sectionSubtitle: A collection of work that demonstrates passion for clean code, intuitive design and innovative solutions

projects.title: Fernanda Fiuza
subDescription: A portfolio for Fernanda Fiuza — movement director, choreographer and audiovisual director whose CORPO CÂMERA research treats the camera as an extension of the body. She has directed movement for Tove Lo, Marina Sena, IZA and Getúlio Abelha and for brands like Natura and Cheetos, with work recognized from Brazil's Prêmio Arcanjo de Cultura to Cannes.

The site is built to disappear behind the footage: a dark, editorial home page that is itself a full-screen grid of her films, each tile quietly looping a preview so browsing feels like watching a reel.
The hard part was making a video-saturated site feel weightless — every preview streams adaptively and is tuned per browser so the grid stays smooth and immediate, with no spinners or stutter.
Fernanda manages all of it herself through a visual CMS: adding projects, curating photo galleries and editing her bio, with no code and no developer in the loop.
A fullscreen photo gallery, PT/EN with instant language switching, and continuous deployment — live in production at fernandafiuza.com.

projects.title: SOLTO®
subDescription: E-commerce platform built with Next.js 14, TypeScript and Drizzle ORM.
Complete administrative panel with product, order, customer, promotion, collection management and real-time analytics.
Optimized checkout with multiple payment methods and automatic shipping calculation.
Responsive and modern design with Tailwind CSS, optimized for all devices.
Scalable architecture with SSR/SSG, intelligent caching and React Query.

projects.title: Interactive 3D Portfolio
subDescription: Personal portfolio developed with Three.js and React, featuring immersive 3D navigation.
Planetary navigation system with smooth transitions and realistic physics animations.
Responsive interface adaptable for desktop and mobile with optimized controls.
Modular architecture with Zustand state management and Framer Motion animations.
Optimized performance with lazy loading, code splitting and efficient rendering.

projects.title: StoreHub
subDescription: Corporate system for CNPJ consultation and registration developed for Reckitt with React 18, TypeScript and Vite.
Hybrid authentication system with Microsoft MSAL (Azure AD) for production and mock provider for development.
Individual and batch CNPJ consultation, new client registration, existing data editing and CSV import functionality.
Backend API with Node.js handling data validation with Zod and comprehensive error handling middleware.
Azure Static Web Apps deployment with CI/CD pipeline, automated testing suite with Playwright and PowerShell scripts.
